posts.text: 🖥 Bahrain’s crackdown on clerics will ‘deepen gap between state and society’: Velayati 📌 Tehran, IRNA – Ali-Akbar Velayati, a senior adviser to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, criticized the Bahraini authorities over their pressure on clerics and the crackdown on civil demands, emphasizing that such behavior “will deepen the gap between the state and society.” In a post on his X account addressing Bahraini rulers, Velayati wrote: Forcing pressure on clerics, particularly Ayatollah Sheikh Isa Qassim, and the suppression of civil demands in Bahrain will only deepen the gap between the government and society. ​ “The gap will not be repaired by the worn-out US security guarantees, nor by the mirage of normalization with Israel. In the authentic Islamic discourse, political legitimacy originates from the will of the people and will not endure without their consent,” the senior adviser stressed. 📲 @Irna_en ​

Status-6 For additional context, the incident occurred while large-scale multinational military exercises were underway at the nearby Nowa Dęba training ground. The exercise, codenamed 'KOALICJA 26.2,' is hosted by Poland and involves troops from 11 countries participating in the so-called 'Coalition of the Willing' (Multinational Force–Ukraine, or MNF-U). Today, the Nowa Dęba training area is set to mark the culmination of the drills with an MNF-U command briefing, a dynamic tactical, logistical, and medical demonstration, an aerial parade, and speeches by defence ministers from several NATO countries. I don't think this is a coincidence. On November 20, 2026, at around 6:30 a.m. local time, an aerial object believed to be a Russian Kh-101 air-launched cruise missile impacted a field in the vicinity of the settlement of Nowy Lipowiec, Lublin Voivodeship, in eastern Poland. The incident occurred during a large-scale Russian missile and drone attack on Ukraine, involving roughly 80 cruise missiles, up to 20 ballistic missiles, and about 400 drones. Polish authorities have already reacted to the event, with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk confirming that there was a violation of Polish airspace and informing the public that relevant services were already working at the scene of the explosion. Notably, the explosion occurred just 70km away from the Nowa Dęba training ground, a major Polish military training area in southeastern Poland's Podkarpackie Voivodeship. Since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine began in February 2022, Polish airspace has been violated multiple times by Russian munitions and aircraft. The most notable incidents included the fall of a Kh-55 cruise missile 450km deep inside Poland in December 2022, a mass incursion by Gerbera long-range UAVs in September 2025, as well as the impact of a Kh-101 cruise missile in Lublin Voivodeship in July 2026. - Status-6 tweet

Merz stressed that Germany and its partners will not abandon their efforts to achieve peace for Ukrainians. He warned that Vladimir Putin’s war extends far beyond Ukraine, describing it as a direct challenge to Europe’s security, democratic values, freedom, and way of life. The German Chancellor’s remarks reinforce Berlin’s position that Ukraine’s security is inseparable from Europe’s future. His message also underscores the broader strategic stakes of the war, with European leaders increasingly framing support for Ukraine as essential to defending the continent’s own security and democratic order. রাজশাহীর দুই বিএনপি নেতার আশ্রয় থেকে কার্যক্রম নিষিদ্ধ আওয়ামী লীগ ও যুবলীগের দুই নেতাকে গ্রেফতার করেছে পুলিশ। বৃহস্পতিবার রাতে গোপন সংবাদের ভিত্তিতে পুলিশ তাদের গ্রেফতার করে। নাটোরের লক্ষ্মীপুর ইউনিয়ন যুবলীগের সভাপতি হাবিবুর রহমান হাবিবকে রাজশাহীর পুঠিয়ার বিএনপি নেতার শ্বশুর বাড়ি থেকে গ্রেফতার করেছে পুলিশ। পুঠিয়া পৌরসভার সাবেক মেয়র বিএনপি নেতা আল মামুনের শ্বশুর বিএনপি নেতা আব্দুর রশীদের কাঁঠালবাড়িয়া গ্রামের বাড়িতে দীর্ঘ দিন ধরে আত্মগোপনে ছিলেন হাবিব। বৃহস্পতিবার (১৯ নভেম্বর) রাতে গোপন সূত্রে খবর পেয়ে ওই বাড়ি থেকে যুবলীগ নেতা হাবিবকে গ্রেফতার করে পুলিশ।
